subject: Control plane upgrade - temporary connectivity cascade (private deployment)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acme.systems>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T16:05:00Z
Subject: Control plane upgrade - temporary connectivity cascade (private deployment)

Hi Sanjay —

Quick heads-up: during the control-plane upgrade we rolled to your private VPC cluster at 15:58 UTC and observed a cascading control-plane reconnection issue that caused API control paths to retry for ~9 minutes. You likely saw increased request timeouts and a small number of inference failures between 15:58–16:07 UTC; customer-facing traffic was still served via the service fallback but latency spiked for some routes.

What we did immediately:
- Pushed an automatic rollback to the previous control-plane revision at 16:07 UTC.
- Applied a temporary routing policy to prefer regional proxies for your tenant to reduce cross-node rehandshakes.
- Opened INC-20261007-ACME and prioritized logs.

We're still collecting traces and will share a concise timeline and the remediation plan by EOD PST. We will not proceed with further upgrades to your private cluster until we complete an investigation and run the extended preflight.

Attachments: controlplane-err-snippet.txt (small excerpt of agent logs)

Apologies for the disruption — we know even brief blips are disruptive. I'm on standby and will coordinate the post-incident follow-up with Laura and our SRE lead Evelyn.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Customer Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acme.systems>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T16:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Control plane upgrade - temporary connectivity cascade (private deployment)

Thanks Marcus —

We saw a bunch of 503s on the inference endpoints and a couple of internal alerts from our API gateway at ~11:59 PDT. Our support team captured traces and a flamegraph; do you want us to upload them to the ticket? We also got paged by one of our product teams.

A few questions:
1) Did the rollback fully restore all control-plane endpoints?
2) Was customer data touched or retried on the host side?
3) We are tracking this under our change window notes and will need a short incident summary for our internal postmortem.

Also, we rely on the scheduled private-upgrade window next Tuesday for the next security patch — we need to understand whether it will be safe to keep that date.

Sanjay
VP Platform Engineering, Acme Systems

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acme.systems>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Control plane upgrade - temporary connectivity cascade (private deployment)

Sanjay — thanks, and yes please upload your traces to INC-20261007-ACME (link: https://redwood.support/incident/INC-20261007-ACME).

Short answers:
1) Rollback: yes — the control-plane revision rollback completed at 16:07 UTC and all API control endpoints returned to normal health by 16:12 UTC. We observed reduced error rates after rebalancing region proxies.
2) Data exposure: no customer data was modified or leaked. Some in-flight requests were retried by our agent and a fraction failed; we will enumerate affected request ids in the incident summary.
3) Upgrade window: we recommend pausing the Tuesday upgrade until we complete a targeted preflight and an expanded canary sequence (we'll propose a new schedule once we finish the RCA).

Immediate next steps (what Redwood will deliver):
- Short timeline + impact mapping (by 10/08 02:00 UTC).
- Full log bundle and request id list (by 10/08 10:00 UTC).
- A revised upgrade plan with extended canary and health-gates (by 10/09 EOD).
- A follow-up call if you prefer a live walkthrough.

I've attached a minimal SRE runbook excerpt we used for the rollback for transparency (sre_runbook_upgrade_backout.pdf).

— Marcus

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acme.systems>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T01:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Control plane upgrade - temporary connectivity cascade (private deployment)

Hi all — quick technical supplement from SRE:

Preliminary root-cause hypothesis: during the control-plane upgrade we introduced a timing change to the agent handshake that, when combined with a spike in kv-cache invalidations, led to simultaneous reconnections across a subset of nodes in your cluster. The reconnections caused leader-election churn in a small control-plane shard and produced short-lived proxy flaps.

Why rollback helped: the previous revision contained a conservative connection backoff and a slightly different lease renew cadence — restoring it prevented the simultaneous reconnect storms.

Planned mitigations (short term):
- Add a staggered agent-restart window and randomized jitter to handshake attempts.
- Extend canary population and ramp-up time by 4x for private clusters.
- Add an extra health gate that checks leader stability metrics before proceeding.

Deliverables and owners:
- Detailed RCA doc + event timeline (Evelyn, 10/09 14:00 UTC).
- Test harness replay of your traces (Marcus + SRE, 10/09 22:00 UTC).
- Proposed new upgrade schedule and canary plan (Laura, 10/09 EOD).

We'll include the request ids you provide to reproduce the exact failure in our CI replay.

— Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@acme.systems>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T11:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Control plane upgrade - temporary connectivity cascade (private deployment)

Sanjay —

Thanks again for uploading the traces; the replay matched our hypothesis and we've captured a full list of affected request ids in INC-20261007-ACME. Laura will coordinate the make-good conversation (service credit / scheduling) and we will deliver the RCA doc and replay artifacts as promised.

Proposed customer-facing items:
- Incident summary (one-page, non-technical) — Laura (by 10/09 18:00 UTC).
- Technical RCA with timeline and replay artifacts — Evelyn (by 10/09 14:00 UTC).
- New upgrade window proposal with extended canary — Marcus + Laura (by 10/09 EOD).

If that works, I'll schedule a 30-minute review call for Monday to walk through the RCA and confirm the new upgrade date for your security patch.

Appreciate your patience — we aim to make these upgrades non-disruptive going forward.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Customer Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
